chunks: "The believer remains in a state of devotional following and spiritual reward so long as he remains upon wudu (ablution)."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: al-Sadiq, the title of Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer, one characterized by iman (faith)
key_terms.مُعَقِّبٌ: one who remains engaged in devotional state or ongoing spiritual reward
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: wudu (ablution), the state of ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of remaining in a state of wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that maintaining wudu (ablution) keeps the believer in an ongoing state of blessed devotional presence and reward. The hadith highlights the spiritual value of ritual purity beyond the immediate performance of salat (prayer).
